react_native_issues.issue: Repeated console warning ‘"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".’ across most screens — non-blocking cosmetic. Reference: theme shared styles.
Warning ‘props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents’ — non-blocking. Occurs on Modal overlay in wizard/legacy screens.
‘[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web’ — expected web limitation.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cosmetic: migrate remaining shadow* style props → boxShadow to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings across theme (also carried over from iteration 26).

Optional UX: consider ALSO rendering a small ‘already answered today ✓’ CTA that opens /wellness for retro-note, so testers/users see the companion card is not dead when answered_today=true. Current behaviour (question + care-note + no mood buttons) is per spec — flagging only because the review request expected companion-mood-5/3/1 to always render.

Consider hardening healing/close idempotency test: currently second-close returns 404 which is fine, but a very fast double-tap could still race. Not a bug — current UX is single button + navigation resets state.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/healing.py (335 lines, within limit): asyncio.gather(_fire_insurance_claim, _fire_waitlist_hunter) is truly parallel — MongoDB writes to insurance_claims + waitlist + calendar_events happen concurrently, then a single neural_bus doc with triggered=['insurance_claim','waitlist_hunter'] logs the event. Correct implementation of the ‘simultaneous’ contract. ✓
healing_state auto-advances bureaucracy → done when recovery.start_date exists — nice implicit chaining without an explicit step tap. ✓
healing_claim_submit uses update_one with $set + guard {status:'prefilled'} so a duplicate submit is impossible (matched_count==0 → 404). Race-safe. ✓

healing_injury_event marks any pre-existing active journey as ‘superseded’ before creating the new one — good, avoids orphan actives per user. But: the superseded journey's claim & waitlist rows are NOT re-associated / cancelled. Consider a cleanup or status flip on the old claim (still ‘prefilled’) if this is user-visible.

_fire_insurance_claim.daily fallback: when no policy exists it uses 15.0 EUR default; when premium_monthly is 0 it still yields 12.0 EUR — reasonable but the constant should be documented (magic numbers 0.8, 12).

companion_greeting uses (utc.hour+2)%24 as ‘Europe/Prague CEST approximation’ — incorrect during winter (Prague is CET UTC+1). Off by 1h from Nov→Mar. Not breaking, but recommend zoneinfo('Europe/Prague') for correctness.
companion_checkin low-mood push wrapped in try/except (silent) ✓. reply strings are hard-coded Slovak — fine for Slovak-only app.
voice_echoes: heard endpoint returns {'ok': True} even when no match (update_one silently no-op). Consider returning 404 for unknown echo_id to help detect frontend bugs.

neural.py._gather_context: healing_loop and companion sub-objects are correctly wrapped in None-safe accessors; insurance_claim lookup by journey_id may return an OLD claim if a journey has been superseded but not marked (see comment above). Cosmetic only.

frontend/app/healing.tsx (299 lines): STEP_ROUTES + STEP_CTA maps make the CTAs data-driven and dead-button-free. Modal wizard is a Pressable overlay (not a full Modal component from RN) so keyboard/back-button behaviour is fine on web. ✓ Uses tap('heavy') haptics — appropriate.
